description: Invalid event logs and policies fail closed before any replay: a reused event id (even dated after any cutoff), a revoke without or with an unknown target, malformed fields and lines, an event that declares its own authority, ambiguous duplicate JSON keys, and malformed policies; a CRLF log stays valid.

validation.name: main
validation.note: the last line reuses e2 for a reject dated 10-20; the whole log is validated, so no cutoff can skip it

validation.name: valid
validation.note: the same log without the reused id loads, so each variant below differs from a valid log by one defect

validation.name: unknown-supersedes
validation.error: event e3 supersedes unknown event e9
validation.note: a revoke naming an id that is not in the log

validation.name: revoke-without-target
validation.note: a revoke that names nothing

validation.name: supersedes-on-approve
validation.note: an approve may not claim to replace another event

validation.name: naive-timestamp
validation.note: an effective time without a timezone is ambiguous

validation.name: unknown-action
validation.note: 'veto' is not an action

validation.name: no-evidence
validation.error: List should have at least 1 item
validation.note: every event cites at least one piece of evidence

validation.name: risk-without-note
validation.note: a risk must say what the risk is

validation.name: dependency-without-target
validation.note: a dependency must name what it depends on

validation.name: self-declared-authority
validation.note: an event carrying 'authorized' and 'role' fields is refused, not trusted: authority comes only from policy.json

validation.name: empty-actor
validation.error: String should have at least 1 character
validation.note: an event needs an actor

validation.name: not-an-object
validation.note: a JSON array line

validation.name: truncated-line
validation.note: a line cut off mid-record

validation.name: crlf-log
validation.note: CRLF line endings in the log are only line breaks

validation.name: duplicate-key-event
validation.note: the approve line names its actor twice ('lin', then 'zhou'); JSON parsers disagree on which one wins, so an authority log must refuse the line rather than silently pick the authorized one

validation.name: duplicate-key-policy
validation.note: 'lin' is listed twice in actors (engineer, then product_manager); an ambiguous grant must fail closed rather than silently grant the last one

validation.name: policy-unknown-action
validation.note: the policy grants an action that does not exist

validation.name: policy-extra-key
validation.note: an unknown top-level 'admins' key is refused, not ignored

validation.name: policy-role-string
validation.error: Input should be a valid list
validation.note: roles given as a string, which must not be read as a list of characters
